implementation.identity: TargetSelection(persistent parent,region); Greene region0..2 maps weak_0..2, -1 is an ordinary actor or damageable mother core. Request/Ack carry region. Transient TARGET_LOCK_REGION attachment is not persisted across lives; request sequence rejects older same-parent region replies.
implementation.validity: Mother targetable gate plus intact region and actual nonempty posed skin; core uses coreDamageable, not collapse/exposed alone. Client and server reject removed/dead/allied/protected hulls and invalid region. Selected region visibility and range apply to that same exposed surface.
implementation.cycle: Tab chooses the crosshair region when present; otherwise the best visible in-view selection. Repeated Tab cycles visible regions with wraparound. Sneak+Tab releases. Other entity locks retain their original toggle-to-release behavior. HUD labels the actual region.
implementation.aim: Client camera, remote facing, real FirearmAim, existing lockPoint consumers including throws, and prototype melee approach/yaw share the selected region point. Shots and melee still collide physically; no forced distant hit or redirection to a chosen region.
implementation.aircraft: Aircraft candidate/selection, visible posed airframe points, parent-preserving server lock, ordinary firearm ballistic lead/actual projectile collision and existing protection retained. This is not a newly invented homing-missile system.

aircraftMelee.source: assets/blacklight/military/helicopter-model.json; same bone offsets and authored child pivots/rotation as HelicopterModel, yaw/bank as HelicopterRenderer. Door slide, gun yaw/pitch, hijack canopy pose included.
aircraftMelee.exclusions: Rotor blade phase is not network authoritative; rotating blades and expendable missile meshes are not structural hull receivers. No enclosing rotor disk/broad airframe box is treated as damage surface.
aircraftMelee.gates: Existing active weapon windows/reach/whip or body-flight sweep, actual nearest posed cuboid surface with .03 block contact tolerance, loaded path and block LOS, one accepted hit per aircraft per ordinary action, occupant allegiance/PvP, player AttackEntityEvent and still-current session check.
aircraftMelee.health: Existing prototype health-unit multiplier, no fabricated native firearm identity or armor coefficient. Permission callback changing actor position/aircraft pose or cancelling the action invalidates the old contact.
